moment: The start-of-term feast in the Great Hall at Hogwarts
title: An Ogre Gets Sorted
story: Hufflepuff values loyalty, patience, and apparently swamp maintenance. Shrek has joined the feast, but he’s still checking whether the pumpkin juice comes with onions.
world: The start-of-term feast fills Hogwarts’ Great Hall with floating candles, overflowing platters, and extremely questionable table manners. Find the unexpected Hufflepuff before he asks to take the leftovers home.

characters.name: Shrek
quips: This castle needs a swamp.
Finally, a house with decent snacks.
Keep the sorting hat out of my ears.
characters.line: Yellow and black? Fine. But I’m not sharing my onions.

characters.name: Harry Potter
quips: Could we have one normal feast?
I haven’t even touched the treacle tart.
Try the Hufflepuff table.
characters.line: Not me. My scar isn’t green.

characters.name: Hermione Granger
quips: He’s not in Hogwarts: A History.
There must be an admissions policy.
Look carefully, not randomly.
characters.line: Honestly, do I look like an ogre?

characters.name: Albus Dumbledore
quips: All appetites are welcome here.
An intriguing addition to Hufflepuff.
Perhaps offer him a lemon drop.
characters.line: No, merely an unusually well-bearded headmaster.

characters.name: Rubeus Hagrid
quips: Seems a lovely fellow.
Bet he’d get on with Fang.
Save him a bit o’ roast.
characters.line: Big doesn’t mean ogre, yeh know.

characters.name: Severus Snape
quips: Do stop pointing.
An ogre. How academically promising.
Keep him away from my ingredients.
characters.line: Your powers of observation remain pitiful.

characters.name: Minerva McGonagall
quips: No swamp water on the flagstones.
The hat’s decision is final.
Kindly remain seated during dinner.
characters.line: I am conducting the Sorting. Focus.

hint.text: Look behind the blond student halfway along the left-hand yellow-and-black table.
